source_evidence: Form Type for the annual report on Form 10-K filed by domestic public companies is “10-K.”
answer: EDGAR lets you research public companies by reviewing their SEC filings. To find an annual report, search for the company by name or ticker symbol and look for the filing labeled “10-K.” A Form 10-K includes audited annual financial statements, discussion of material risk factors, and management’s discussion and analysis of the company’s results of operations for the prior fiscal year.
